title: Service Credit Base for Billing-Error Corrections, Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan
content:
Bluegate adds a billing-error service credit to a billing-error correction on a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan. The service credit is figured on the service-credit base, which is read from the fee ledger collections for the billing period of the charge in error.

## The base

| What the fee ledger shows for the billing period of the charge in error | Service-credit base |
| --- | --- |
| the period's fee was collected twice | the two collections of the period together |
| the period's fee was collected once | the charge in error alone |
| otherwise (no collection for the period) | nothing — no service credit is figured |

Stated as a rule: the service-credit base is the two collections of the period together when the period's fee was collected twice, the charge in error alone when the period's fee was collected once, and nothing otherwise.

## Training questions

**The period was charged twice and the tenant paid both charges. What is the base?** The two collections of that period together. With two hypothetical collections of 29.00 each, the base is 58.00.

**The period was charged twice but only one collection was recorded for it. What is the base?** The charge in error alone — for a hypothetical charge in error of 29.00, a base of 29.00, whatever the amount of the single collection.

**No collection is recorded for the period. Is there a service credit?** No service credit is figured; the base is nothing.

**Which period's collections are read?** Only the billing period of the charge in error; collections for other periods do not enter the base.
